name: Active Incident: Multi-System Failure
description: A production server is experiencing a cascading failure. Four simultaneous issues are present: (1) disk is at 93% due to a large log file, (2) nginx has a broken config preventing restart, (3) a runaway process is consuming 70%+ CPU, and (4) a critical cron job is failing silently. Students must triage, prioritise, and fix in the correct order.
